summary.text: Mike Neese is a Republican state representative from South Carolina House District 44 who has served since November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a contractor from Indian Land and a former chamber of commerce president and CEO.

paragraphs.text: Mike Neese was born in Virginia and lives in Indian Land, South Carolina.
He earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from Appalachian State University in 1991, and his career experience includes working as a contractor.
Neese has served as the president and CEO of the Greater Indian Land Chamber of Commerce and as president of the Indian Land Rotary Club.
He assumed office on November 14, 2022, succeeding Sandy McGarry.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
